observations: Large blue and grey industrial machine cabinet with open access doors.
Control panel features a small digital display and multiple physical buttons/switches.
Internal mechanical assembly includes pneumatic cylinders and vertical guide rails.
A watermark 'JENAISE INDUSTRY' is visible across the center of the image.
The machine is located outdoors or in a loading bay near a shipping container and a truck trailer.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the main blowing unit, but the automatic preform loader is not visible to confirm fully automatic operation.
The machine appears used, but there is no evidence of it currently being connected to power or air for production.

claims.claim: make pet plastic bottles of different [sizes]
claims.evidence: While this is the purpose of such machines, no molds are shown to verify size capabilities.

risks.risk: The machine may have critical electronic or pneumatic failures.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine completing a full dry-cycle or production cycle.

risks.risk: Essential auxiliary equipment (high-pressure compressor, air dryer, chiller) may be missing.
risks.proof: Photos of the accompanying compressor and cooling units.
risks.if_unproven: as the blowing unit only, requiring significant additional investment

risks.risk: Unknown production capacity and manufacturer specifications.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's metal nameplate/data plate.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's nameplate showing the model, year, and technical specs.
Video of the machine powered on and operating.
Photos of any included molds and auxiliary equipment like the air compressor and chiller.
Photo of the preform loading system to verify 'automatic' claim.
response.reason: Valuation of industrial machinery depends entirely on the manufacturer's specifications and operational status. Without a nameplate or proof of function, it cannot be distinguished from a non-working unit or a lower-capacity model.
